reports.title: Gross Domestic Product by Industry - Provincial and Territorial (Annual)
reports.description: Statistics Canada's annual provincial and territorial GDP-by-industry programme (IMDB record 1303; the programme page reads Status: Active, Frequency: Annual), the output side of the provincial and territorial accounts. Its published table is 36-10-0402-01, 'Gross domestic product (GDP) at basic prices, by industry, provinces and territories' (formerly CANSIM 379-0030), whose Statistics Canada product page names this programme as its source; that table was retired after its 2025-05-01 release and the page names table 36-10-0711-01 under the same title as its replacement. Minted 2026-09-06 on Thomas's ruling, after yt-statistical-review was found citing 36-10-0402-01 by number in its own figure-source lines: neither statcan-provincial-economic-accounts (36-10-0222-01, GDP by income and by expenditure) nor statcan-gdp-monthly (the national monthly by-industry estimate) is this artefact. Table number resolved against the agency's own product page in this round per PLAYBOOK-CORPUS §7a condition 1 (www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3610040201, read 2026-09-06). NOT aliased: 36-10-0711-01, the successor number, which no document in this corpus cites.
reports.cadence_note: Annual. The IMDB programme page records its most recent data release as May 1, 2026.

dependencies.basis: RETARGETED 2026-09-06 (Thomas's ruling) from statcan-national-accounts, which was the wrong release: the Yukon Statistical Review's GDP figures are the annual provincial and territorial by-industry estimates, not the quarterly national accounts. The Review's own tables 11.9 and 11.10 carry the figure-source line quoted below, which names the table by number; under PLAYBOOK-CORPUS §7a a figure-source line is a citation, and an agency's own product number names the artefact. The number was resolved against Statistics Canada's own product page in this round per condition 1 (www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3610040201, read 2026-09-06): 'Gross domestic product (GDP) at basic prices, by industry, provinces and territories', Frequency: Annual, source programme 'Gross Domestic Product by Industry - Provincial and Territorial (Annual)', which is the target node. The Review sets its table numbers with U+2011 non-breaking hyphens, which is why every earlier pass missed them; normalizeForMatch folds U+2011 to an ASCII hyphen, and the quote below was copied out of the extraction rather than retyped.
